{{Top|leg}}
'''Flesh Disguises''' or '''flesh concealment kits''' were the replicas of the face, hands, and feet of another person produced by [[Illicit Electronics]]' [[Flesh camouflage]]. The replications were effective at a distance, and the face had an electronic link that allowed the wearer to modify the pitch and tone of the voice to match with the person who they were impersonating.
